Senior Trade Marketing Manager – Italy

Location: Milan

Contract type: Fixed-term contract (maternity leave)

Team description

Italy is one of SumUp's most important retail markets, with major national accounts, more than a thousand partner stores, and a dedicated field team bringing our products to shelves across the country. You'll join at a pivotal moment, picking up an established set of account plans, in-store programmes and product launches, and keeping that momentum going without missing a beat. It's a role that blends retail strategy with hands-on execution, giving you real ownership over how SumUp shows up in Italian stores.

What you'll do

• In partnership with the Business Development Manager, lead trade marketing strategy for the Italian market, driving sell-out across major retail accounts and partner stores
• Manage and coordinate the local field team of 15 people, including a Field Operations Manager, Project Managers and Merchandisers, to hit shared targets
• Partner with Business Development Managers to turn demand projects, such as promotional plans, product launches and in-store tests, into results on the shelf
• Monitor in-store execution and product visibility, building action plans to keep standards high across retail partners
• Collaborate with the Marketing Development team to shape Italy-specific campaigns that fit the local retail landscape
• Oversee the external field agency relationship, including performance management and contract coordination

You'll be great for this role if…

• Proven experience in trade marketing or retail marketing within the Italian market, ideally with established relationships across major retailers
• Comfort leading external teams and agencies, with strong coordination and people management instincts
• Strong project management skills, with the ability to track multiple workstreams and keep delivery on schedule
• Confident communication in both Italian and English, including the ability to produce clear, structured business documents
• Ability to move easily between strategic planning and hands-on, day-to-day execution

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our inspiring Milan location. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 22 days of annual paid leave, 32 hours of Ex Festività (Personal Hours), plus public holidays and special leave days

💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future

❤️ Well-being support: access our mental health Employee Assistance Programme for guidance and care when you need it

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team
